scope: Two bounded solo Studio physics checks. Initial setup is separate from the forced jump recorder; no in-run test reposition or checkpoint writes.
usage: Submit commands[name] through the existing HeartwoodVerification bridge with a fresh JobId. Require outer ok=true and inspect result.passed. For the jump, run catch_edge_setup, capture bridge_state, run the source-loaded recorder once, then capture bridge_state again. Root owns setup, live execution, and the joined evidence report.

forcedJump.dependencies: recipeSource is the saved file text; beforeState is the prior bridge result.result table, supplied by root. The recorder requires no ModuleScript access or require call.
forcedJump.initialSetup: catch_edge_setup is a separate bridge command. It is the only reposition/progress setup. Confirm result.passed before calling the recorder. Start with a standard official racer, normal WalkSpeed16/JumpHeight7.2/Gravity196.2, and wait out recovery immunity.
forcedJump.selection: Northwest Catch edge toward J3: source top bounds leave about 5 studs in X and 4 in Z, with roughly 1.4 studs to J3 center horizontally. Actual collidable Catch.Top support is required, so the mesh bounds alone cannot authorize a jump. J3 floor is 21 studs higher than Catch; a normal jump is 7.2 studs.
expectedEvidence: Before: grounded Catch.Top support, close to the selected takeoff, server root ownership, no active recovery immunity, checkpoint3 and Racing in the bridge snapshot.

Actual jump: jumpCommands == 1, jumpObserved == true, sawAirborne == true, upward velocity and actualRise recorded; inspect actual Humanoid stateChanges and immediatelyAfterCommand rather than assuming the request lifted the avatar.
Trajectory: actual apex/highestFootY, attempted J3 receiver, bounded state/support samples, exact first receiver.Top spatial overlaps, and receiverLanded requiring four grounded J3 frames.

After: preserve recorder.after and bridge state. Compare checkpoint/status plus hits, acknowledgements, releases, cancels, lastRecovery. The recorder observes RecoveryUntil increases but cannot read Runtime recovery-source diagnostics without the bridge.
Any direct-receiver-bypass-observed result is a defect candidate. jump-command-without-observed-lift, setup refusal, character change, or timeout cannot establish useful skip prevention.

If the jump physically occurs and returns to Catch or recovers without J3 landing, report only prevention in this one forced attempt; do not claim every possible edge, wall route, or human input has been tested.
limits: GetPartsInPart records spatial overlap, not an engine contact event. Underside/side overlap is explicitly separate from grounded receiver landing.
One normal jump under the nearby J3 footprint checks the real higher receiver attempt. It does not screen every scenic collider or combinations of repeated jumps.
Bridge before/after must confirm zero unintended bloom acknowledgement/release and preserve checkpoint3; those counters are not available to this source-only recorder.

finishChecks: Require result.passed == true, completedSteps == 4, withinRunRepositions == 0, all four step.jumps == 0, final grounded allowed F0.Top/F0.SanctuaryArtwork/FinishWalk_4 support, distance <=4, checkpoint3, status Finished.

Require no hits or RecoveryUntil increase between result.before and result.after. FinishWalk_1 is a child of J4; the exact endpoint joins allow only the next listed ramp, not arbitrary course geometry.
jump=false disables the verification scanner. State.autojump should already be false in the standard setup; the recipe does not change Humanoid tuning.

finishFixtureEvidence.source: Root-reported representative native HA04 no-jump run; raw failed recipe evidence is retained by root.
finishFixtureEvidence.observed: All four steps used zero jumps with no hits or recovery. Racing became Finished at distance2.797 on exact Decoration.S04_SanctuaryBough.F0.SanctuaryArtwork support; normal race-finish movement freeze then held the character there.
finishFixtureEvidence.correction: Admit exact SanctuaryArtwork support and distance<=4 to unchanged F0 centre: native Finish marker26x5x3 accepts avatar contact, then PlayerRaceService anchors movement. A final-form full run froze at3.329 while Finished/grounded/CP3 with zero hits or recovery. Preserve failed fixture trace; rerun unchanged geometry with corrected assertion.
finishFixtureEvidence.boundary: This corrects a support assertion, not physical geometry or movement tuning. The representative observation showed no finish lip defect. Root owns the final corrected HA04 rerun.

collisionSourceReview.scope: Read-only Art/ArtManifest source screening; current native HA04 collider properties still require root confirmation.
observations: Original upper bough04 bound minimumY206.34, bough05 minimumY247.34, bough06 minimumY326.96, bough07 minimumY369.36. These minima are above the highest bloom takeoff140 + ideal112-speed boost rise31.97 + typical avatar body clearance~6.

Added BoughFamily08-13 are source-guarded minimumY>=191.2; BarkRib relief has minimumY>195. Current source makes BarkRib solid. Both bands are above this bounded route/flight envelope, even if all boughs become solid in HA04.

Hollow upper walls are mostly continuous sloped vertical shells. Their broad bounds do not establish a walkable top or wall-jump route; existing lower solid boughs and buttresses are unchanged in this source snapshot.
collisionSourceReview.reasonNoAdditionalProbe: No new physically reachable ledge or short section-to-section bridge is identified from source. Do not spend a live replay on distant upper scenery based only on a bounding box. A newly observed grounded scenic ledge near the route would justify one separately selected probe.
